steps.title: Housing: sketch and extrude
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as housing.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane. Rectangle (Two Point Center) 60 by 40 on the origin. Finish Sketch.
Extrude. Distance A: 30 mm. Click OK.

steps.title: Housing: the 20 H7 hole
actions: Click Hole and place it on the centre of the top face. Simple Hole. Diameter 20 mm. Through All. Click OK.
In the Parameters dialog (Manage tab) you can give the hole diameter the H7 tolerance so the drawing shows it.

steps.title: Housing: round the corners
actions: Click Fillet. Radius 3 mm. Pick the four vertical corner edges. Click OK. Save housing.ipt.

steps.title: Pin: sketch and extrude
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as pin.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane. Circle on the origin, diameter 20. Finish Sketch.
Extrude. Distance A: 45 mm. Click OK.

steps.title: Pin: chamfer the ends
actions: Click Chamfer. Distance 0.8 mm. Pick the edge at each end. Click OK. Save pin.ipt.
steps.note: The g6 tolerance goes on the drawing: the model is at the nominal 20 mm.

steps.title: Assembly: fit the pin
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as fit_pair.iam.
Place housing.ipt and right click, Place Grounded at Origin.
Place pin.ipt. Constrain > Mate: pick the pin axis and the hole axis.
Constrain > Flush with an offset of 5 mm: the bottom of the pin 5 below the bottom of the housing. Click OK.
